title: Highrise Protocol
description: A procedural Three.js FPS benchmark built by Qwen3.8-Flash-Next from a single prompt in omp: volumetric light, godrays and motes over a rooftop skyline, spring recoil with red-dot ADS, ragdoll flinch and wave survival. Being a vision model, it took its own screenshots mid-run and graded the frames itself.
